subject.title: Add option to hide session status card

question: Should OpenClaw add a core status-card visibility config for chat `/status` and `session_status`, and should it hide the whole rendered card or only privacy-sensitive sections such as usage and cost?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the new config surface and permanent output shape affect privacy, agent UX, docs, schema compatibility, and whether status remains a mandatory diagnostic surface.

options.title: Add documented visibility control
options.body: Introduce a default-on setting or section allowlist that keeps current output for existing users while allowing operators to suppress the card or sensitive lines.

options.title: Limit to privacy sections
options.body: Add a narrower usage/cost suppression setting if maintainers want to solve the sensitive-data concern without broad status-card modes.

options.title: Reject new config surface
options.body: Keep status cards always visible and close the request as not planned if the extra configuration is not worth the product and maintenance cost.

recommendation.title: Add documented visibility control
recommendation.body: Introduce a default-on setting or section allowlist that keeps current output for existing users while allowing operators to suppress the card or sensitive lines.
